result.summary: The page is mostly well-designed, but one restaurant card shows a broken delivery price ('€NaN'), indicating a data/formatting bug. Horizontal carousels also clip content at the right edge without a clear scroll affordance.

issues.description: The 'Smash Bros Burgers' card displays '€NaN delivery' instead of a valid price, indicating a failed numeric parse or missing/invalid delivery fee value.
issues.suggestion: Fix the data source or formatting logic so a valid currency value renders (e.g. '€1.90 delivery' or 'Free delivery'); add a fallback for null/undefined fees so 'NaN' never reaches the UI.

issues.description: Horizontal carousels ('Fastest near you' and the category chips) clip items at the right edge (e.g. 'Trattoria Piccol...' and a partially visible chip) with no visible scroll indicator.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle scroll affordance such as a fade-out gradient, partial-card peek with consistent spacing, or pagination dots so users know more content is available horizontally.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' is truncated without a guaranteed ellipsis or full-name access, which can hurt readability and tap-target clarity.
issues.suggestion: Ensure text truncation uses a proper ellipsis and expose the full name via tooltip/accessibility label, or allow two-line wrapping for restaurant titles.
